summary: re:Director is a containerised application designed to handle domain redirection tasks. It provides a centralised interface for managing URL forwarding rules rather than relying on manual server block configurations. The project is implemented in Java and distributed under the Apache-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators who prefer a dedicated self-hosted utility to manage multiple HTTP redirects in one place.
watchOut: The project has a modest community footprint and a relatively early version release, meaning you may encounter rough edges or limited documentation compared to established reverse proxies.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based Java application, you will typically need to allocate sufficient memory for the Java Virtual Machine and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
